waypoint_reference: Object centre Q in desk D; empty waypoints use a virtual held-object centre, not firmware TCP.

example_only.yaw: task-specific; not inferred from image without frame/tool mapping

accepted: buffer used for held-object waiting only
user_review.standby_correction: Remove I=(500,130,160); use fresh actual pose to select/validate a standby joint configuration. Do not restore the old Cartesian placeholder.
user_review.note: Accepted sequence and zone purpose do not authorize physical motion.

orientation.physical_gripper_long_axis: vertical downward during grasp, carry and placement; measured mapping required
orientation.yaw: solve grasp yaw with fixed-finger side and source object orientation; preserve object-to-tool attachment for return
orientation.closure: incremental bounded closure using validated grip criterion; no universal g angle or assumed force sensing
orientation.constraint: IK must satisfy orientation at every sample; interpolation of joints alone does not guarantee verticality or straight XYZ.

timing.note: No speeds, forces or settling times are authorized by this geometric draft.

confirmation.arrival: fresh joint feedback + measured tolerances + consecutive arrival samples; HTTP ok/firmware FK XYZ alone is insufficient
confirmation.payload: manual observation at L_TEST for first validation; no automatic held-object detector is claimed
confirmation.support: manual/dummy support confirmation during first validation; no uninstalled contact sensor is assumed
confirmation.vacancy: reserve original pose; verify fresh object/tool-envelope vacancy from unoccluded view or manual confirmation

return.from_pick_descent_empty: stop; validated vertical withdrawal to P0 then I; no payload return
return.from_test_lift_or_high_above_original: verified vertical return over original footprint only if vacant and controllable
return.from_B: B -> original P0 (high XY line, validation required)
return.from_PRE: PRE -> PRE_HIGH -> B -> original P0, validated branches only
return.from_H_before_release: validated carrying withdrawal to PRE, then return branch; requires hand clearance, else hold
return.from_mid_segment: controlled stop using measured dynamics; choose approved connector from actual stopped state, never snap to last waypoint
placement: verify vacant footprint and tool envelope
vertical controlled approach preserving return object yaw
local vertical withdrawal after tool-clear check
return.post_delivery: retreat empty; never retrieve from recipient automatically

protocol_boundary.wire_units: six joint channels incl gripper; Q16.16 rad; not desk millimetres
protocol_boundary.grasp_submission: HOME -> PRE_DELIVERY; exactly one F_GRASP; samples/digest and real-execution gates required
protocol_boundary.required_integration: map I to verified HOME, PRE to verified PRE_DELIVERY; implement/version task-specific dynamic return in PS/PL state machine; existing fixed-tray assumptions must be audited

evidence_limits: prior physical grasp is local single-object evidence, not whole-route validation
2026-10-24 upward shoulder errors about 3 degrees remain unresolved
D/camera/base/tool transforms and real IK are not deployment-validated
H reach and hand/camera visibility need priority review
